recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source edit is needed; redundant wording changes would risk disturbing later accepted Vocabulary guidance without changing implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-6308 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary issue from DSTU1 asking to replace wording that described an element as bound to an extensible value set with wording that makes clear the element is bound using extensible strength to a value set.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 5722, now git commit 4bb9a06d8c4c846cd8f8447dc2fc80426104be40, which changed the Extensible Binding Strength section in source/terminologies.html from the old extensible-value-set phrasing to an extensibly-bound-element phrasing.
additional_context: Later FHIR-29968 work rewrote the same Extensible Binding Strength section and aligned parallel binding-strength terminology artifacts. The current page explicitly says the value set binding is extensible, not the value set itself, and May 2018 Vocabulary minutes independently record the same distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/terminologies.html already satisfies the requested clarification and is active build source through source/hierarchy.xml and source/fhir.ini.

related_jiras.note: Rewrote the Extensible Binding Strength section and reinforced the current data-element/value-set expansion wording.
